title: Free-energy device in Stan Meyer's archive in Michigan

tellings.quote: So my science advisor Dr. Loader went and saw this warehouse full of floppy disc and devices but he had one thing of great interest.

plain: A warehouse in Michigan holding the archive of the late inventor Stan Meyer is said to be full of floppy disks and devices, and one item in it is said to be a free-energy device, a machine meant to put out more power than it takes in. Steven Greer, a physician who campaigns for UFO secrets to be made public, tells Michels that his science advisor, Dr. Ted Loder, went and saw the warehouse, and he points to a photo posted on the website dpiarchive.com. If it were true, a working source of nearly limitless energy would be sitting forgotten in storage.
